test_ensure_admin_user_first_boot_noop: test that _ensure_admin_user returns early without creating admin on first boot when no users exist
test_ensure_admin_user_triggers_migratio: test that _ensure_admin_user calls _migrate_orphaned_threads when an admin user already exists in the database
test_migrate_orphaned_threads_stamps_use: test that _migrate_orphaned_threads stamps admin user_id on unowned store items while preserving already-owned items
test_iter_store_items_pagination: test that _iter_store_items walks multiple pages using cursor-style iteration until a short page terminates the loop
test_ensure_admin_user_edge_cases: test that _ensure_admin_user handles missing store, missing session factory, and migration failures without crashing
